title: —For England...
html_source:
Song by John Braham from the opera ‘The Americans’ (1811)

For England, home, and beauty!
He cried, as ‘midst the fire he ran:
'England shall find that every man
This day will do his duty!’

(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rswNerDQaHc)
